text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe fennuɓe Annabaaku maa: wanaa min Allah adii nulude, sakko ŋalɗon e ko mi noddata on e mun kon, ɗuuɗuɓe adinoke lam. Awa kadi, mi anndaa ko Allah waɗatammi, maa ko O waɗata on aduna. Min on jokkaa, si wanaa ko Allah woni wahayinnde kon e am; mi wowlataa mi huuwataa, si wanaa ko yaadi e wahayu. Mi laataaki, si wanaa jertinoowo on e lepte Allah ɗen, ɓannginana on ɗum.
